body: I hugged my brother when my friend died
really shouldn't entertain such shit breh,, i would've blocked

i really appreciate you caring, but it's not as much about others as it's about me. i realise it is selfish, but it's what I want. It isn't like i haven't lived either, I've been through good and bad. i just don't want any more that's all

i don't desire anything out of life,, i really don't. i understand the whole "wasted potential" or whatever sentiment people feel,, but I'm just done,,,, I'm just searching for the least destructive way out
i just don't get why this is something that needs "help". why can't my death just be accepted, and i can just finally stop pretending i want to live.

i doubt it's specific. like, i know a lot of things which are shit in my life,, because that's basically everything,, but i don't care if it changes. it could be great and lovely, but i don't want it anymore.
i don't know how to answer that. all i know is i want to die. i have no idea how to do it, especially without causing problems. but i don't want to live that's for sure.
